## SmartBeam 1.2.0

- Adds a dim purple LED indication during OTA updates while keeping the beam and battery LEDs on their normal indications.
- Reports BLE host task allocation failures during startup instead of treating BLE startup as successful.
- Adds persistent lifetime counters for device runtime, battery runtime, beam breaks, and boots, available through a read-only Device Information BLE characteristic.
- Fixes lifetime-log storage and battery-runtime counting when USB connection state changes.
- Production firmware is signed with Secure Boot V2 and uses release-mode flash-encryption provisioning.
